enchantment.reforged.lifesteal.desc: Heals you for a portion of the damage you deal.
enchantment.reforged.auto_smelt.desc: Smelts mined blocks as they drop.
enchantment.reforged.vein_miner.desc: Mines connected ore blocks in one go.
enchantment.reforged.magnet.desc: Sends what you mine straight to your inventory.
enchantment.reforged.auto_replant.desc: Replants mature crops you harvest, using a seed from your inventory.
enchantment.reforged.blink.desc: Right-click to hurl your blade and teleport to where it lands. The sword stays in your hand.
enchantment.reforged.lumberjack.desc: Fells connected logs in one chop; the top level takes down the whole tree.
enchantment.reforged.tunneler.desc: Mines a flat 3x3 to 5x5 face in one go, one block deep.
enchantment.reforged.reaper.desc: Harvests every mature crop in a 3x3 to 5x5 area around the one you break.
